findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The doctor's lib loader may catch generically and print err.message, in which case the relabel improves its output exactly as the spec claims and no change is needed.
findingDetails.case: A fresh clone runs the doctor before provisioning: the contract lib now throws SHARED_NOT_BUILT at load, and any consumer that recognizes only MODULE_NOT_FOUND no longer matches the failure.
findingDetails.claim: The relabeled SHARED_NOT_BUILT error has exactly one updated handler (ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs:63); the doctor path the spec asserts as an edge case is covered by no test in this change and the doctor file is unchanged.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: exact_search for SHARED_NOT_BUILT over .skilled returns only the throw site and the gate's catch; the spec claims the doctor's existing line already carries the provision command.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: Reading parent-skill-check.cjs's lib loader and finding a code-agnostic catch, or running the clone scenario against the doctor, closes this as verified.
findingDetails.recommendation: Extend the clone ledger (L-1/L-2) or a test to run parent-skill-check.cjs in the unprovisioned tree and assert its line names the provision command; adjust the doctor's catch only if it branches on MODULE_NOT_FOUND.
findingDetails.scopeProof: grep for SHARED_NOT_BUILT over .skilled shows only root-router-contract.cjs:83 (throw) and ci-skill-root-metadata.cjs:63 (handler); no other handler exists in the changed set.
findingDetails.title: Only the gate catches the relabeled load failure; the spec's doctor edge case has no coverage
findingDetails.userImpact: If the doctor branches on MODULE_NOT_FOUND, a fresh-clone user sees a raw stack from the doctor instead of the named provision command - the failure R5 exists to remove. Unverified in either direction; no observed regression.
